invariants.rationale: The method always returns the 'result' object which is instantiated at the start and never set to null.
getWriteStatuses() is populated during execution and should not be null on a valid return.
result is parameterized as HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, so getWriteStatuses() should return a List.
All WriteStatus entries added to the list come from valid sources, so should not be null.
A List's size is always non-negative.
